Method of Attack: Trojanized versions of unofficial WhatsApp mods that bundle malware to snatch notifications from Google Play Store and Samsung Galaxy Store via Flurry stat service
Downloads additional APK from command and control server URL and requests user to install it disguised as an update
Displays arbitrary dialog boxes with remotely updated content to redirect users to malicious sites
Attack Vector: APK downloads from shady websites promoted by social media posts, forums, and SEO poisoning
